*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: G:\0.DỰ ÁN\ERP-GiaoThong-DongNai\2.SQL\patches\2026-10-19\FAM-DeviceDep\02_20261019_FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_migrate.sql
+/*
+	Patch  : Khởi tạo chính sách khấu hao cho TSCĐ đủ điều kiện
+	Date   : 2026-10-19
+	Module : FAM
+	An toàn : @IsCommit = 0 chỉ xem trước và Rollback; đổi thành 1 sau khi duyệt kết quả.
+	Quy tắc:
+		- Chỉ TSHH/TSVH; loại DC, QSDD, KHAC, tài sản con, đã xóa, thanh lý.
+		- Price > 0.
+		- MethodID mặc định = 1.
+		- Đã khấu hao (Price > RemainPrice): giữ nguyên opening legacy tại đầu tháng hiện tại.
+		- Chưa khấu hao: bắt đầu từ UsingDate; nếu thiếu dùng đầu tháng hiện tại.
+		- UsefulLifeMonths ưu tiên UsingLengthMonth, sau đó UsingLength * 12.
+*/
+Set Nocount On
+Set Xact_Abort On
+
+Declare @IsCommit bit = 0,
+	@currentMonth date,
+	@migrationUser nvarchar(50) = N'sql-migration'
+
+Set @currentMonth = Convert(date, Convert(char(6), Getdate(), 112) + '01', 112)
+
+If Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]', N'U') Is Null
+Begin
+	Raiserror(N'Chưa có bảng dbo.FAM_DeviceDepPolicy. Hãy chạy patch schema trước.', 16, 1)
+	Return
+End
+
+If Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_Device]', N'U') Is Null
+	Or Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceKind]', N'U') Is Null
+	Or Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceGroup]', N'U') Is Null
+	Or Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceCategory]', N'U') Is Null
+	Or Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceStatus]', N'U') Is Null
+Begin
+	Raiserror(N'Thiếu bảng danh mục hoặc bảng tài sản FAM cần cho migration.', 16, 1)
+	Return
+End
+
+Select
+	FAM_Device.DeviceID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceCode,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceName,
+	FAM_Device.Price,
+	FAM_Device.RemainPrice,
+	FAM_Device.UsingDate,
+	FAM_Device.UsingLengthMonth,
+	FAM_Device.UsingLength,
+	FAM_Device.IsLineDep,
+	FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryCode,
+	FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceGroupCode,
+	FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindCode,
+	FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusCode,
+	Case
+		When Isnull(FAM_Device.UsingLengthMonth, 0) > 0 Then FAM_Device.UsingLengthMonth
+		When Isnull(FAM_Device.UsingLength, 0) > 0 Then FAM_Device.UsingLength * 12
+		Else Null
+	End As ProposedUsefulLifeMonths,
+	Case
+		When Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.Price, 0))
+			> Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.RemainPrice, FAM_Device.Price))
+			Then @currentMonth
+		Else Convert(date, Isnull(FAM_Device.UsingDate, @currentMonth))
+	End As ProposedDepreciationStartDate,
+	Case
+		When Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.Price, 0))
+			> Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.RemainPrice, FAM_Device.Price))
+			Then @currentMonth
+		Else Convert(date, Isnull(FAM_Device.UsingDate, @currentMonth))
+	End As ProposedMigrationOpeningDate,
+	Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.RemainPrice, FAM_Device.Price)) As ProposedMigrationOpeningValue,
+	Case
+		When Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.Price, 0))
+			> Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.RemainPrice, FAM_Device.Price))
+			Then Convert(decimal(18,2), FAM_Device.Price - Isnull(FAM_Device.RemainPrice, FAM_Device.Price))
+		Else Convert(decimal(18,2), 0)
+	End As ProposedAccumulatedOpening
+Into #tblEligibleDevice
+From [dbo].[FAM_Device]
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceKind] on FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindID = FAM_Device.DeviceKindID
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceGroup] on FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceGroupID = FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceGroupID
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceCategory] on FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryID = FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceCategoryID
+	Left Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceStatus] on FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusID = FAM_Device.DeviceStatusID
+Where Isnull(FAM_Device.IsDeleted, 0) = 0
+	and Isnull(FAM_Device.ParentDeviceID, 0) = 0
+	and Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.Price, 0)) > 0
+	and FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryCode In (N'TSHH', N'TSVH')
+	and FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryCode <> N'DC'
+	and FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceGroupCode <> N'QSDD'
+	and FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindCode <> N'KHAC'
+	and Isnull(FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusCode, N'') <> N'Thanh lý'
+
+-- Select before: các tài sản sẽ tạo policy hoặc chuẩn hóa IsLineDep.
+Select
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceID,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceCode,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceName,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceCategoryCode,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceGroupCode,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceKindCode,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.Price,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.RemainPrice,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedDepreciationStartDate,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedUsefulLifeMonths,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedMigrationOpeningDate,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedMigrationOpeningValue,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedAccumulatedOpening,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.IsLineDep As CurrentIsLineDep,
+	Case
+		When FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceDepPolicyID Is Null Then N'INSERT_POLICY'
+		When Isnull(#tblEligibleDevice.IsLineDep, 0) <> 1 Then N'UPDATE_FLAG_ONLY'
+		Else N'NO_CHANGE'
+	End As MigrationAction
+From #tblEligibleDevice
+	Left Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]
+		on FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID = #tblEligibleDevice.DeviceID
+Order By #tblEligibleDevice.DeviceCode
+
+Begin Transaction
+
+Insert Into [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]
+(
+	DeviceID,
+	MethodID,
+	DepreciationStartDate,
+	UsefulLifeMonths,
+	IsDepreciable,
+	MigrationOpeningDate,
+	MigrationOpeningValue,
+	AccumulatedOpening,
+	EffectiveFrom,
+	StatusID,
+	Description,
+	CreatedDate,
+	CreatedUser
+)
+Select
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceID,
+	1,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedDepreciationStartDate,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedUsefulLifeMonths,
+	1,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedMigrationOpeningDate,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedMigrationOpeningValue,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedAccumulatedOpening,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.ProposedMigrationOpeningDate,
+	1,
+	N'Khởi tạo chính sách khấu hao đường thẳng; giữ nguyên số dư legacy tại thời điểm migration.',
+	Getdate(),
+	@migrationUser
+From #tblEligibleDevice
+Where Not Exists
+(
+	Select 1
+	From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]
+	Where FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID = #tblEligibleDevice.DeviceID
+)
+
+Update FAM_Device
+Set
+	IsLineDep = 1,
+	UpdatedDate = Getdate(),
+	UpdatedUser = @migrationUser
+From [dbo].[FAM_Device]
+	Inner Join #tblEligibleDevice on #tblEligibleDevice.DeviceID = FAM_Device.DeviceID
+Where Isnull(FAM_Device.IsLineDep, 0) <> 1
+
+-- Select after: kết quả trong transaction; với @IsCommit = 0 dữ liệu sẽ Rollback.
+Select
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceDepPolicyID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceCode,
+	#tblEligibleDevice.DeviceName,

+		MonthlyDepValue = OriginalValue / UsefulLifeMonths.

+
+If Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod_Preview]', N'P') Is Not Null
+	Drop Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod_Preview]

+
+Create Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod_Preview]
+(
+	@YearID int,
+	@MonthID tinyint,
+	@OfficeID int = null,
+	@PlaceID int = null,
+	@DeviceKindID int = null,
+	@DeviceStatusID int = null,
+	@Keyword nvarchar(100) = null,

+As

+
+	Declare @periodFrom date,
+		@periodTo date,
+		@daysInPeriod smallint
+
+	If @YearID < 1900 Or @YearID > 9999 Or @MonthID Not Between 1 And 12
+	Begin
+		Raiserror(N'Kỳ khấu hao không hợp lệ.', 16, 1)
+		Return
+	End
+
+	Set @periodFrom = Convert(date, Convert(char(4), @YearID) + Right('0' + Convert(varchar(2), @MonthID), 2) + '01', 112)
+	Set @periodTo = Convert(date, Dateadd(Day, -1, Dateadd(Month, 1, @periodFrom)))
+	Set @daysInPeriod = Datediff(Day, @periodFrom, @periodTo) + 1
+
+	If Exists
+	(
+		Select 1
+		From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod]
+		Where StatusID = 2
+			and PeriodTo >= @periodFrom
+			and Isnull(OfficeID, 0) = Isnull(@OfficeID, 0)
+	)
+	Begin
+		Raiserror(N'Đã tồn tại kỳ khấu hao được ghi nhận từ tháng được chọn trở đi. Hãy hoàn nhập kỳ sau trước.', 16, 1)

+
+	If Nullif(Ltrim(Rtrim(@Keyword)), N'') Is Not Null

+
+	;With PolicySource As
+	(
+		Select
+			FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceDepPolicyID,
+			FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID,
+			FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MethodID,

+			FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningDate,

+			FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.EffectiveFrom,

+			FAM_Device.DeviceName,
+			FAM_Device.DeviceStatusID,
+			FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusCode,
+			FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusName,
+			FAM_Device.DeviceKindID,
+			FAM_Device.OfficeID,
+			FAM_Device.PlaceID,
+			FAM_Device.Price,
+			FAM_Device.RemainPrice,
+			FAM_Device.IsDeleted,
+			FAM_Device.ParentDeviceID,
+			FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryCode,
+			FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceGroupCode,
+			FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindCode,
+			PreviousPeriod.ClosingValue As PreviousClosingValue,
+			PreviousPeriod.AccumulatedDepValue As PreviousAccumulatedDepValue
+		From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]
+			Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DepMethod] on FAM_DepMethod.MethodID = FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MethodID
+			Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_Device] on FAM_Device.DeviceID = FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID
+			Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceKind] on FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindID = FAM_Device.DeviceKindID
+			Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceGroup] on FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceGroupID = FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceGroupID
+			Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceCategory] on FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryID = FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceCategoryID
+			Left Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceStatus] on FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusID = FAM_Device.DeviceStatusID
+			Outer Apply
+			(
+				Select Top 1
+					FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.ClosingValue,
+					FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.AccumulatedDepValue

+					Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod]

+					and FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.PeriodTo < @periodFrom
+				Order By
+					FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.PeriodTo Desc,
+					FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodDetailID Desc
+			) PreviousPeriod
+		Where FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.StatusID = 1
+			and FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.EffectiveFrom <= @periodTo

+			and (@PlaceID Is Null Or FAM_Device.PlaceID = @PlaceID)
+			and (@DeviceKindID Is Null Or FAM_Device.DeviceKindID = @DeviceKindID)
+			and (@DeviceStatusID Is Null Or FAM_Device.DeviceStatusID = @DeviceStatusID)
+			and
+			(
+				@Keyword Is Null
+				Or FAM_Device.DeviceCode Like @Keyword
+				Or FAM_Device.DeviceName Like @Keyword
+			)
+	),
+	OpeningSource As
+	(
+		Select
+			PolicySource.*,
+			Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(PolicySource.PreviousClosingValue, PolicySource.MigrationOpeningValue)) As OpeningValue,
+			Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(PolicySource.PreviousAccumulatedDepValue, PolicySource.AccumulatedOpening)) As AccumulatedBefore,
+			Convert(decimal(18,2), PolicySource.Price) As OriginalValue,
+			Case
+				When PolicySource.UsefulLifeMonths > 0
+					Then Round(Convert(decimal(18,6), PolicySource.Price) / PolicySource.UsefulLifeMonths, 2)
+				Else Convert(decimal(18,2), 0)
+			End As MonthlyDepValue,
+			Case
+				When PolicySource.DepreciationStartDate > @periodFrom Then PolicySource.DepreciationStartDate

+		From PolicySource
+	),
+	CalculationSource As

+		Select

+				When OpeningSource.EligibleFrom > @periodTo Then 0
+				Else Datediff(Day, OpeningSource.EligibleFrom, @periodTo) + 1
+			End As EligibleDays,
+			Case
+				When OpeningSource.DepreciationStartDate >= @periodFrom
+					and OpeningSource.DepreciationStartDate <= @periodTo
+					Then Round(
+						OpeningSource.MonthlyDepValue
+						* (Datediff(Day, OpeningSource.DepreciationStartDate, @periodTo) + 1)
+						/ Convert(decimal(18,6), @daysInPeriod),
+						2)
+				When OpeningSource.DepreciationStartDate < @periodFrom Then OpeningSource.MonthlyDepValue
+				Else Convert(decimal(18,2), 0)
+			End As CalculatedDepValue
+		From OpeningSource
+	),
+	ResultSource As
+	(
+		Select
+			CalculationSource.*,
+			Case
+				When Isnull(CalculationSource.IsDeleted, 0) <> 0
+					Or Isnull(CalculationSource.ParentDeviceID, 0) <> 0
+					Or CalculationSource.OriginalValue <= 0
+					Or CalculationSource.DeviceCategoryCode Not In (N'TSHH', N'TSVH')
+					Or CalculationSource.DeviceCategoryCode = N'DC'
+					Or CalculationSource.DeviceGroupCode = N'QSDD'
+					Or CalculationSource.DeviceKindCode = N'KHAC'
+					Or Isnull(CalculationSource.DeviceStatusCode, N'') = N'Thanh lý'
+					Or CalculationSource.IsDepreciable = 0
+					Or CalculationSource.DepreciationStartDate > @periodTo
+					Then 3
+				When CalculationSource.MethodID <> 1 Or CalculationSource.IsExecutable = 0 Then 4
+				When Isnull(CalculationSource.UsefulLifeMonths, 0) <= 0 Then 3
+				When CalculationSource.OpeningValue <= 0 Then 2
+				Else 1
+			End As ResultStatusID,
+			Case
+				When Isnull(CalculationSource.IsDeleted, 0) <> 0 Then N'Tài sản đã xóa.'
+				When Isnull(CalculationSource.ParentDeviceID, 0) <> 0 Then N'Tài sản con không khấu hao độc lập.'
+				When CalculationSource.OriginalValue <= 0 Then N'Nguyên giá phải lớn hơn 0.'
+				When CalculationSource.DeviceCategoryCode Not In (N'TSHH', N'TSVH')
+					Or CalculationSource.DeviceCategoryCode = N'DC' Then N'Không thuộc nhóm tài sản cố định được khấu hao.'
+				When CalculationSource.DeviceGroupCode = N'QSDD' Then N'Quyền sử dụng đất không thuộc luồng khấu hao này.'
+				When CalculationSource.DeviceKindCode = N'KHAC' Then N'Chủng loại KHAC chưa xác định đủ điều kiện.'
+				When Isnull(CalculationSource.DeviceStatusCode, N'') = N'Thanh lý' Then N'Tài sản đã thanh lý.'
+				When CalculationSource.IsDepreciable = 0 Then N'Chính sách đánh dấu không khấu hao.'
+				When CalculationSource.DepreciationStartDate > @periodTo Then N'Chưa đến ngày bắt đầu khấu hao.'
+				When CalculationSource.MethodID <> 1 Or CalculationSource.IsExecutable = 0 Then N'Phương pháp chưa hỗ trợ thực thi.'
+				When Isnull(CalculationSource.UsefulLifeMonths, 0) <= 0 Then N'Thiếu thời gian sử dụng theo tháng.'
+				When CalculationSource.OpeningValue <= 0 Then N'Đã khấu hao hết.'
+				Else N'Đủ điều kiện ghi nhận.'
+			End As ResultMessage
+		From CalculationSource
+	)
+	Select
+		ResultSource.DeviceDepPolicyID,
+		ResultSource.DeviceID,
+		ResultSource.DeviceCode,
+		ResultSource.DeviceName,
+		ResultSource.DeviceStatusID,
+		ResultSource.DeviceStatusName,
+		ResultSource.OfficeID,
+		ResultSource.PlaceID,
+		ResultSource.MethodID,
+		ResultSource.MethodCode,
+		ResultSource.MethodName,
+		ResultSource.DepreciationStartDate,
+		ResultSource.UsefulLifeMonths,
+		ResultSource.OriginalValue,
+		ResultSource.OpeningValue,
+		ResultSource.MonthlyDepValue,
+		Convert(smallint, ResultSource.EligibleDays) As EligibleDays,
+		@daysInPeriod As DaysInPeriod,
+		Convert(decimal(18,2),
+			Case
+				When ResultSource.ResultStatusID <> 1 Then 0
+				When ResultSource.CalculatedDepValue > ResultSource.OpeningValue Then ResultSource.OpeningValue
+				Else ResultSource.CalculatedDepValue
+			End) As PeriodDepValue,
+		Convert(decimal(18,2),
+			ResultSource.AccumulatedBefore
+			+ Case
+				When ResultSource.ResultStatusID <> 1 Then 0
+				When ResultSource.CalculatedDepValue > ResultSource.OpeningValue Then ResultSource.OpeningValue
+				Else ResultSource.CalculatedDepValue
+			End) As AccumulatedDepValue,
+		Convert(decimal(18,2),
+			ResultSource.OpeningValue
+			- Case
+				When ResultSource.ResultStatusID <> 1 Then 0
+				When ResultSource.CalculatedDepValue > ResultSource.OpeningValue Then ResultSource.OpeningValue
+				Else ResultSource.CalculatedDepValue
+			End) As ClosingValue,
+		ResultSource.ResultStatusID,
+		Case ResultSource.ResultStatusID
+			When 1 Then N'Đủ điều kiện'
+			When 2 Then N'Đã khấu hao hết'
+			When 3 Then N'Chưa đủ điều kiện'
+			When 4 Then N'Chưa hỗ trợ phương pháp'
+		End As ResultStatusName,
+		ResultSource.ResultMessage
+	From ResultSource
+	Where @ResultFilter = 0 Or ResultSource.ResultStatusID = @ResultFilter
+	Order By
+		ResultSource.DeviceCode,
+		ResultSource.DeviceID
+End
+Go

+/*

+Set Ansi_Nulls On

+

+	Drop Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod_Reverse]
+Go
+
+Create Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod_Reverse]
+(
+	@DeviceDepPeriodID bigint,
+	@ReverseReason nvarchar(500),
+	@ReversedUser nvarchar(50)
+)
+As
+Begin
+	Set Nocount On;
+	Set Xact_Abort On;
+	Set Transaction Isolation Level Serializable;
+
+	Declare @periodTo date,
+		@officeID int,
+		@detailCount int,
+		@updatedCount int
+
+	If Nullif(Ltrim(Rtrim(@ReverseReason)), N'') Is Null
+	Begin
+		Raiserror(N'Lý do hoàn nhập không được để trống.', 16, 1)
+		Return
+	End
+	If Nullif(Ltrim(Rtrim(@ReversedUser)), N'') Is Null
+	Begin
+		Raiserror(N'Không xác định được người hoàn nhập.', 16, 1)
+		Return
+	End
+
+	Begin Try
+		Begin Transaction
+
+		Select
+			@periodTo = FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.PeriodTo,
+			@officeID = FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.OfficeID
+		From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod] With (Updlock, Holdlock)
+		Where FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.DeviceDepPeriodID = @DeviceDepPeriodID
+			and FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.StatusID = 2
+
+		If @periodTo Is Null
+		Begin
+			Raiserror(N'Không tìm thấy kỳ đã ghi nhận hoặc kỳ đã được hoàn nhập.', 16, 1)
+		End
+
+		If Exists
+		(
+			Select 1
+			From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod] With (Updlock, Holdlock)
+			Where StatusID = 2
+				and PeriodTo > @periodTo
+				and Isnull(OfficeID, 0) = Isnull(@officeID, 0)
+		)
+		Begin
+			Raiserror(N'Phải hoàn nhập các kỳ sau trong cùng phạm vi trước.', 16, 1)
+		End
+
+		Select @detailCount = Count(*)
+		From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail]
+		Where DeviceDepPeriodID = @DeviceDepPeriodID
+
+		If Isnull(@detailCount, 0) = 0
+		Begin
+			Raiserror(N'Kỳ khấu hao không có chi tiết để hoàn nhập.', 16, 1)
+		End
+
+		If Exists
+		(
+			Select 1
+			From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail]
+				Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_Device] With (Updlock, Holdlock)
+					on FAM_Device.DeviceID = FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceID
+			Where FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodID = @DeviceDepPeriodID
+				and Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.RemainPrice, 0))
+					<> FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.ClosingValue
+		)
+		Begin
+			Raiserror(N'Giá trị hiện tại của tài sản không khớp số cuối kỳ. Không thể hoàn nhập tự động.', 16, 1)
+		End
+
+		Update FAM_Device
+		Set
+			RemainPrice = FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.OpeningValue,
+			UpdatedDate = Getdate(),
+			UpdatedUser = @ReversedUser
+		From [dbo].[FAM_Device]
+			Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail]
+				on FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceID = FAM_Device.DeviceID
+		Where FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodID = @DeviceDepPeriodID
+			and Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.RemainPrice, 0))
+				= FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.ClosingValue
+
+		Set @updatedCount = @@Rowcount
+
+		If @updatedCount <> @detailCount
+		Begin
+			Raiserror(N'Có tài sản thay đổi trong lúc hoàn nhập. Toàn bộ thao tác đã được hủy.', 16, 1)
+		End
+
+		Update [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod]
+		Set
+			StatusID = 3,
+			ReversedDate = Getdate(),
+			ReversedUser = @ReversedUser,
+			ReverseReason = Ltrim(Rtrim(@ReverseReason)),
+			UpdatedDate = Getdate(),
+			UpdatedUser = @ReversedUser
+		Where DeviceDepPeriodID = @DeviceDepPeriodID
+			and StatusID = 2
+
+		If @@Rowcount <> 1
+		Begin
+			Raiserror(N'Trạng thái kỳ đã thay đổi trong lúc hoàn nhập.', 16, 1)
+		End
+
+		Commit Transaction
+
+		Select
+			@DeviceDepPeriodID As DeviceDepPeriodID,
+			@detailCount As RestoredDeviceCount
+	End Try
+	Begin Catch
+		If Xact_State() <> 0
+			Rollback Transaction
+		Declare @errorMessage nvarchar(4000)
+		Set @errorMessage = Error_Message()
+		Raiserror(@errorMessage, 16, 1)
+	End Catch
+End
+Go
*** End Patch

+/*

+	Date   : 2026-10-19
+	Module : FAM
+	An toàn : Chỉ Select; không thay đổi dữ liệu.

+
+-- 1. Tài sản có policy nhưng không còn thỏa điều kiện phân loại TSCĐ.
+Select
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceDepPolicyID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceCode,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceName,
+	FAM_Device.IsDeleted,
+	FAM_Device.ParentDeviceID,
+	FAM_Device.Price,
+	FAM_Device.RemainPrice,
+	FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusCode,
+	FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryCode,
+	FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceGroupCode,
+	FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindCode,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MethodID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.IsDepreciable,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.StatusID
+From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_Device] on FAM_Device.DeviceID = FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceKind] on FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindID = FAM_Device.DeviceKindID
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceGroup] on FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceGroupID = FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceGroupID
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceCategory] on FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryID = FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceCategoryID
+	Left Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceStatus] on FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusID = FAM_Device.DeviceStatusID
+Where Isnull(FAM_Device.IsDeleted, 0) <> 0
+	or Isnull(FAM_Device.ParentDeviceID, 0) <> 0
+	or Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.Price, 0)) <= 0
+	or FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryCode Not In (N'TSHH', N'TSVH')
+	or FAM_DeviceCategory.DeviceCategoryCode = N'DC'
+	or FAM_DeviceGroup.DeviceGroupCode = N'QSDD'
+	or FAM_DeviceKind.DeviceKindCode = N'KHAC'
+	or Isnull(FAM_DeviceStatus.DeviceStatusCode, N'') = N'Thanh lý'
+Order By FAM_Device.DeviceCode
+
+-- 2. Policy thiếu thời gian sử dụng: được Preview nhưng không được Post.
+Select
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceDepPolicyID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceCode,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceName,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DepreciationStartDate,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.UsefulLifeMonths,
+	FAM_Device.UsingLengthMonth,
+	FAM_Device.UsingLength,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningValue,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.AccumulatedOpening
+From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_Device] on FAM_Device.DeviceID = FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID
+Where FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.StatusID = 1
+	and FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.IsDepreciable = 1
+	and Isnull(FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.UsefulLifeMonths, 0) <= 0
+Order By FAM_Device.DeviceCode
+
+-- 3. Policy có số dư migration không hợp lý so với nguyên giá.
+Select
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceDepPolicyID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceCode,
+	FAM_Device.Price,
+	FAM_Device.RemainPrice,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningValue,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.AccumulatedOpening,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningValue + FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.AccumulatedOpening As MigrationTotal
+From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_Device] on FAM_Device.DeviceID = FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID
+Where FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningValue < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.AccumulatedOpening < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningValue > Convert(decimal(18,2), FAM_Device.Price)
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningValue + FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.AccumulatedOpening
+		<> Convert(decimal(18,2), FAM_Device.Price)
+Order By FAM_Device.DeviceCode
+
+-- 4. Bất biến tiền của detail.
+Select
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodDetailID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.OriginalValue,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.OpeningValue,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.PeriodDepValue,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.AccumulatedDepValue,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.ClosingValue
+From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail]
+Where FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.OriginalValue < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.OpeningValue < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.PeriodDepValue < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.ClosingValue < 0
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.PeriodDepValue > FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.OpeningValue
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.ClosingValue
+		<> FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.OpeningValue - FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.PeriodDepValue
+	or FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.AccumulatedDepValue > FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.OriginalValue
+
+-- 5. Trùng tài sản trong cùng kỳ tháng đã ghi nhận.
+Select
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.YearID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.MonthID,
+	Isnull(FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.OfficeID, 0) As OfficeKey,
+	Count(*) As PostedCount
+From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail]
+	Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod]
+		on FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.DeviceDepPeriodID = FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodID
+Where FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.StatusID = 2
+Group By
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.YearID,
+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.MonthID,
+	Isnull(FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.OfficeID, 0)
+Having Count(*) > 1
+
+-- 6. Master không khớp kỳ Posted mới nhất.
+Select
+	FAM_Device.DeviceID,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceCode,
+	FAM_Device.DeviceName,
+	Convert(decimal(18,2), Isnull(FAM_Device.RemainPrice, 0)) As MasterRemainPrice,
+	LatestPosted.ClosingValue As LatestPostedClosingValue,
+	LatestPosted.PeriodFrom,
+	LatestPosted.DeviceDepPeriodID
+From [dbo].[FAM_Device]

+			FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.ClosingValue,
+			FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.PeriodFrom,
+			FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.DeviceDepPeriodID
+		From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail]
+			Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod]

+		Where FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceID = FAM_Device.DeviceID
+			and FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.StatusID = 2
+		Order By

+			FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodDetailID Desc

+

+	FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodID,

+		When 2 Then N'Đã ghi nhận'
+		When 3 Then N'Đã hoàn nhập'
